pages.text: Alchemy requires a suitable furnace, a learned formula, enough spirit herbs, and the required cultivation realm. Failure may consume ingredients or cause a furnace explosion; see alchemy_system.json.
pages.title: Alchemy Process

pages.text: Before adding ingredients, confirm that the furnace formation is complete and unsealed, then check the formula and realm requirements before controlling the flame. Source index: patchouli_item_book.static_entries.alchemy_flow.
pages.title: Before You Begin
